dedupe_keys.name: network digital twin for energy aware zero touch traffic engineering across project

description: This network digital twin turns network telemetry events into automatic, energy-aware traffic engineering decisions, developed at Universidad Politécnica de Madrid for a use case of the European ACROSS project and released on Zenodo in February 2026. Artificial intelligence inference models predict the energy consumption of network equipment for different traffic profiles; the twin monitors telemetry to check these predictions and then drives dynamic routing that forwards traffic along the most energy-efficient paths without manual intervention. Coverage: laboratory and emulated transport networks; any network exposing the expected telemetry. Format and access: source code on Zenodo, free under the Apache 2.0 licence, linked to two related Zenodo deposits. Caveats: a project prototype; models trained on the authors' equipment; documentation is limited. Simulation uses: digital twin and optimisation studies of network energy use and routing, and capacity planning under energy constraints. Related records: the Arcep sustainable digital survey gives national network energy figures.
